title: CancelFanOutJob.v1
description: Cancel a fan-out job: tasks not started become OBSOLETE (CANCELLED) and running ones finish and are discarded (FW-014). Sent by ms-backfill-reconciler when a campaign is paused (DEC-24).
$comment: Source: DISENO 4.4 catalog CMD-05; RF-111, RF-121; US-08.2.1. Producer: ms-backfill-reconciler. Consumers: ms-publish-fanout. Channel: SQS {cell}-ms-publish-fanout-commands. Ordering/partition key: jobId. Idempotency key: jobId. Guarantee: at-least-once. Versioning: additive within v1 (DISENO 4.2). dataClass: OPERATIONAL (DISENO 4.4). Stays inside its cell; operational metadata only (ids, counters, hashes). Response event(s): FanOutCompleted.v1 (CANCELLED).

reason.description: Why ms-backfill-reconciler cancels the job: its campaign was paused (manually or automatically, RNF-035). Operators cancel through POST /v1/jobs/{jobId}:cancel, which sends no message (DEC-24).
